findings.observation: Skin value, freckles, nose, mouth, and hair identity remain related to Meiu, but the chibi replaces her softly lidded adult eyes and soft rectangular high-cheekbone face with a rounder, wide-eyed doll-like template. The loss of her thumb-hook and open-hand pose further weakens source-specific identity continuity.

Meiu remains lean-to-average and very-tall in chibi language through narrow shoulders, a slim compact torso, restrained limb mass, and comparatively long shortened legs; no muscle or body-fat inflation appears.

The arms, wrists, and hands remain natural and reasonably slim, but both source-specific hand configurations drift: the hooked thumb beneath the waist wrap and the relaxed open opposite hand are replaced by two lowered fists.
The matte blue-teal color, loose swept front and side silhouette, parting, gathered mass, and long offset braid remain legibly continuous with the summon and add no ornament or supernatural emission.

The rust-charcoal work shirt, asymmetrical apron layers, repaired seams, contrasting pale inner panel, reinforced trousers, rolled cuffs, sturdy shoes, waist wrap, and small empty medicine pouch remain source-faithful with no tattoo or added accessory.

Original-resolution inspection places the complete top-of-hair-to-chin unit at roughly 29 to 30 percent of top-of-hair-to-lowest-sole standing height, about 3.4 heads total. This misses the frozen 32 to 36 percent gate and the requested 34 to 35 percent aim.
Exactly one coherent subject appears with the complete hair mass, head, braid, both hands, layered apron, both trouser legs, and both shoes fully visible inside generous parchment margins.
The grounded three-quarter stance, staggered sturdy feet, lowered empty hands, and clean silhouette read clearly as a weaponless combat ready-idle at icon scale.

The patched cloth workwear, practical shoes, waist wrap, and empty pouch remain ordinary mortal goods; no weapon, attack, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect appears.

attempts.retryReason: The one source-bound render keeps Meiu lean, very-tall, blue-teal braided, correctly dressed, fully framed, weaponless, and one-star, but it misses the required chibi ratio, drifts to a round wide-eyed doll face, and loses both the thumb-hook and open-hand identity gestures. The instruction authorizes exactly one call, and this experiment requires a new versioned correction target for visual revision.
